## Checks

- [ ] `yarn tsc --noEmit`
- [ ] `yarn test tests/<the ones covering this>.test.ts`
- [ ] `yarn lint`
- [ ] `yarn format` on the files you touched

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before you start. The writing, code, design and layout
rules there are the ones a review will hold you to.
